name: MarkItDown
description:
Converts PDFs, Office files, HTML, EPUB, images (with OCR) and audio (with transcription) into Markdown using Microsoft's MarkItDown. The document arrives from KeepTalking and the Markdown goes straight back as a new file.

An optional AI cleanup pass tidies headings, tables and lists with KeepTalking's own model, only when you allow AI for this plugin in KeepTalking.

kinds.name: markitdown-convert
kinds.description: Convert a document (PDF, Office, HTML, EPUB, images with OCR, audio with transcription…) into clean Markdown

polish.description: Run an AI cleanup pass over the converted Markdown (needs the catalog's AI toggle in KeepTalking; silently skipped when unavailable)

allowedExtensions.description: Source extensions this instance accepts; empty allows all supported formats

maxSourceBytes.description: Largest source file this instance accepts

aiPolish.description: Permit the AI cleanup pass on this instance
